name: Svelte Cubed
summary: Svelte component library for building state-driven Three.js scene graphs, with SvelteKit hot reloading and tree-shaking.
description: Svelte Cubed lets you build Three.js scenes with Svelte components — SC.Canvas, meshes, materials, lights and cameras — instead of imperative code. Install it from npm alongside three; the docs cover getting started, a component reference, examples and FAQs. The project says it is not yet done, so expect missing features and APIs that are not yet set in stone.
contains: component library for Three.js scene graphs in Svelte apps
components: Canvas, Mesh, cameras, lights, materials
works with SvelteKit hot module reloading
